facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Scrooge woke up on Christmas Day. He was alive and happy. He opened the window and shouted. He changed completely.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Scrooge woke up on Christmas morning feeling completely new. He jumped out of bed with a big smile on his old face. He opened the window and shouted Merry Christmas to everyone. He changed completely and became a different person overnight. People on the street could not believe their eyes and ears. The mean old Scrooge was gone and a kind man had taken his place.
